How billing works

  • Pay securely via mobile money, bank transfer, or card.
  • Your subscription activates immediately after payment — no delays.
  • We send reminders 7 days, 3 days, and 1 day before your subscription expires.
  • If you don't renew by the expiry date, you get a 3-day grace period to complete payment.
  • After the grace period, your store is automatically disabled until you renew.
